page_title: GNN Layer Architecture and Dropout Regularization
summary: This page details the components of a single Graph Neural Network (GNN) layer, including transformation, aggregation, and normalization steps. It focuses on the application of dropout as a regularization technique to prevent overfitting and increase expressiveness, distinguishing it from sampling methods. The concept of GNN expressive power is introduced, highlighting the ability to distinguish between different graph structures.
